source.author: verg
source.text: Nec tibi diva parens, generis nec Dardanus auctor, perfide; sed duris genuit te cautibus horrens Caucasus, Hyrcanaeque admorunt ubera tigres.
source.text_original: 'Nec tibi diva parens, generis nec Dardanus auctor, / perfide; sed duris genuit te cautibus horrens / Caucasus, Hyrcanaeque admorunt ubera tigres.
source.text_english: Neither was the goddess your mother, nor the Dardanian founder of your line, traitor; but grim Caucasus brought you forth on its hard cliffs, and Hyrcanian tigresses gave you suck.

reuse.author: hier
reuse.text: quae enim aures tam durae, quae de silice excisa praecordia et Hyrcanarum tigrium lacte nutrita possunt sine lacrimis Paulinae tuae audire nomen?
reuse.text_original: quae enim aures tam durae, quae de silice excisa praecordia et Hyrcanarum tigrium lacte nutrita possunt sine lacrimis Paulinae tuae audire nomen?
reuse.text_english: For what ears are so hard, what hearts cut out of flint and nourished on the milk of Hyrcanian tigresses, could hear the name of your Paulina without tears?
